stdout_text:
Usage: ferry <command> [flags]

Tailnet-only file and directory serving

Flags:
  -h, --help       Show context-sensitive help.
  -j, --json       Output as JSON
  -V, --version    Show version and exit

Commands:
  publish <path> [flags]
    Publish a file or directory

  list [flags]
    List active shares

  get <id> [flags]
    Get a share by id

  unshare <target> [flags]
    Revoke a share by id or exact path

  renew <id> [flags]
    Extend share expiry

  doctor [flags]
    Check daemon and Tailscale health

Run "ferry <command> --help" for more information on a command.
change: C4: a parse error exits 2 with one error line instead of the usage text and exit 80
